Total token supply minted to the deployer address in the constructor.
Mapping of account address to token balance; mutated by transfer and transferFrom.

External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) executed after the allowance write.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an arbitrary user-supplied token contract.
Arithmetic operation c = a + b inside safeAdd, guarded by require(c >= a).
Arithmetic operation c = a - b inside safeSub, guarded by require(b <= a).
Arithmetic operation c = a * b inside safeMul, guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Arithmetic operation c = a / b inside safeDiv, guarded by require(b > 0).
Checked addition helper returning a + b and requiring no overflow.
Checked subtraction helper returning a - b and requiring b <= a.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner directly from the caller-controlled msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership state changes.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
transferAnyERC20Token is guarded by onlyOwner, which checks msg.sender against owner.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] with the caller controlled address.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using the caller address as key.
transferFrom spends allowed[from][msg.sender] using the caller as spender key.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using the caller address.
msg.sender is forwarded as the from argument into the external receiveApproval callback.
onlyOwner reads the owner state variable for the authorization check.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner, promotes it to owner and resets it to address(0).
transferOwnership writes the _newOwner parameter into the newOwner state variable.
IUPToken constructor assigns the symbol state variable.
IUPToken constructor assigns the name state variable.
IUPToken constructor assigns the decimals state variable.
IUPToken constructor mints and stores the total supply.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from the stored supply.
balanceOf returns the value stored in the balances mapping.
balanceOf looks up balances using the tokenOwner parameter as the key.
transfer reads and writes balances for both the sender and the recipient.
transfer uses the to parameter as the balance credit key.
transfer passes the tokens parameter into safeSub and safeAdd.
transferFrom updates balances[from] and balances[to] in the balances mapping.
transferFrom uses the from parameter to key balances and allowed.
transferFrom uses the to parameter as the credit account.
transferFrom passes the tokens parameter into safeSub and safeAdd.
approve writes the granted amount into the allowed mapping.
approve stores the allowance under the spender parameter key.
approve stores the tokens parameter as the allowance value.
transferFrom decrements the allowed[from][msg.sender] entry before crediting the recipient.
allowance returns a value read from the allowed mapping.
allowance keys the mapping with the tokenOwner parameter.
allowance keys the mapping with the spender parameter.
approveAndCall writes the allowance before triggering the external callback.
approveAndCall stores the allowance under the spender parameter key.
approveAndCall stores and forwards the tokens parameter.
approveAndCall forwards the data parameter to the external callback.
The allowed mapping is updated immediately before the external receiveApproval callback, allowing reentrant state reads and further approvals.
transferAnyERC20Token uses the tokenAddress parameter for the external interface cast.
transferAnyERC20Token forwards the tokens parameter to the external token contract.
The owner address is passed as the recipient of the external ERC20 transfer.
transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom calls safeSub twice on balances and allowances.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
safeAdd executes the c = a + b arithmetic operation guarded by an overflow require.
The a parameter feeds the addition inside safeAdd.
The b parameter feeds the addition inside safeAdd.
The addition result is assigned to the return local c.
safeSub executes the c = a - b arithmetic operation guarded by require(b <= a).
The a parameter feeds the subtraction inside safeSub.
The b parameter feeds the subtraction inside safeSub.
The subtraction result is assigned to the return local c.
safeMul executes the c = a * b arithmetic operation with an overflow require.
The a parameter feeds the multiplication inside safeMul.
The b parameter feeds the multiplication inside safeMul.
The multiplication result is assigned to the return local c.
safeDiv executes the c = a / b arithmetic operation guarded by require(b > 0).
The a parameter feeds the division inside safeDiv.
The b parameter feeds the division inside safeDiv.
The division result is assigned to the return local c.
approveAndCall hands control to an arbitrary spender contract through receiveApproval while state is already updated.
transferAnyERC20Token hands control to an arbitrary token contract through transfer, enabling reentrancy into owner-restricted flows.
